articles.title: PhRMA Advocates for Itemized Billing in 340B Drug Program Reform
articles.summary: PhRMA is pushing for itemized billing requirements within the 340B drug pricing program to increase transparency regarding how covered entities utilize discounts. This policy debate impacts the broader drug pricing and supply chain ecosystem that affects self-funded employer health plan costs and PBM operations.

articles.title: Pharma Defends 340B Rebate Model Amid Ongoing Industry Scrutiny
articles.summary: Pharmaceutical companies are taking strategic steps to defend the current 340B rebate model as legal and regulatory pressures mount. This ongoing battle significantly impacts the broader drug pricing ecosystem, specialty drug distribution, and cost dynamics that affect self-funded employer health plans.

articles.title: Pennsylvania Files Lawsuit Against Major Pharma and PBMs Over Insulin Pricing
articles.summary: The state of Pennsylvania has launched legal action against major pharmaceutical manufacturers and pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs) over inflated insulin prices. This lawsuit adds to the growing regulatory and legal scrutiny surrounding PBM business practices and drug pricing transparency, which directly impacts self-funded employers managing specialty drug costs.

articles.title: Alternative PBM Satisfaction Declines, Narrowing Advantage Over Big Three
articles.summary: Employer satisfaction with alternative and transparent PBMs saw a decline, reducing the historical satisfaction gap between them and the traditional Big Three PBMs. This trend indicates that self-funded employers are demanding better performance and more measurable ROI from all PBM models as healthcare cost pressures intensify. The shift highlights the need for alternative PBMs to continuously prove their value proposition in managing employer drug spend.
articles.source_line: Source: Drug Channels; Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:00:00 GMT

articles.title: New York Pharmacists Urge Governor Hochul to Sign PBM Transparency Bill
articles.summary: Independent pharmacists in New York are ramping up pressure on Governor Kathy Hochul to sign a newly passed PBM transparency bill aimed at addressing reimbursement rates. This state-level legislation highlights the ongoing regulatory scrutiny and legislative pushbacks facing PBM practices, which directly impacts market dynamics for self-funded employers operating in the state.
articles.source_line: Source: Spectrum News; Tue, 20 Oct 2026 22:51:00 GMT

articles.title: Epic Integrates Major Pharmacy Alternatives to Enhance Rx Pricing Transparency
articles.summary: Electronic health record giant Epic has partnered with Amazon Pharmacy, LillyDirect, and Mark Cuban Cost Plus Drug Company to launch a prescription drug pricing and fulfillment tool. This integration allows clinicians and patients to compare cash prices and alternative fulfillment channels directly at the point of prescribing, posing a significant challenge to traditional PBM retail networks. For self-funded employers and PBMs, this trend toward price transparency and bypass models increases pressure on plan design and pharmacy benefit management strategies.
articles.source_line: Source: Word & Brown General Agency; Tue, 20 Oct 2026 18:00:21 GMT

articles.title: Net Launch Prices for New Prescription Drugs Surge 35%
articles.summary: A recent analysis reveals that the net launch prices for new prescription drugs increased by 35% between 2022 and 2025. This significant escalation in initial drug costs directly impacts overall pharmacy benefit spend and challenges self-funded employers trying to manage long-term plan affordability. The trend underscores the growing financial pressure of new market entries on employer-sponsored health plans.
articles.source_line: Source: American Hospital Association; Tue, 20 Oct 2026 21:06:22 GMT

articles.title: Sullivan County Legislature Votes to Transition Employee Benefits to Self-Insurance
articles.summary: The Sullivan County legislature has voted to shift its employee health benefits to a self-funded model. This move highlights the growing trend of public and private entities adopting self-insurance to gain better control over healthcare and pharmacy benefit costs. For self-funded market participants, it underscores the ongoing expansion of the addressable market as plan sponsors seek alternatives to fully insured arrangements.
articles.source_line: Source: Sullivan County Democrat; Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:10:00 GMT

articles.title: State Policymakers Flag Specialty Drug Prices as Major Cost Challenge
articles.summary: State-level policy discussions have highlighted specialty drug prices as a primary driver of escalating healthcare expenditures. This focus underscores the growing pressure on self-funded employers who bear the financial brunt of high-cost specialty therapies within their pharmacy benefits.
articles.source_line: Source: State Affairs Pro; Tue, 20 Oct 2026 03:31:27 GMT
